verdict.seen: Microwave on a table with purple-pink wave rays angled down onto two food pieces inside the open cabinet.
Rays hit the food; across the strip one piece turns orange hot while the other turns pale frosty white.
A glass turntable appears under the food; the frosty piece ends up orange, so both halves glow hot.
Pink rays extend out through the open front of the oven past the frame, with a LEAKING label.
A dark mesh door covers the front and the rays stay inside; no leaking rays outside.
A glowing yellow outline surrounds the microwave oven on its table.
Mesh-door microwave with rays on glowing orange food; the food looks nearly static across frames and only the outline fades.
verdict.problem: The food does not visibly shake; add a jiggle or vibration to the food so the shaking reads across frames.

verdict.seen: Orange outward arrows are visible in front of the food, pointing left and right, in the oven.
Orange inward arrows point toward the food from both sides of the mesh door.
A black control panel with a green display (timer) and keypad buttons appears on the oven front; the light is the green display on the finished microwave on the table.
Camera pulls back to show the whole finished microwave with keypad on its table in the kitchen, fully in view.
